europe_now.title: Businesses warned of sabotage threats
europe_now.summary: British authorities have urged organizations supporting Ukraine to take immediate protective measures against potential Russian sabotage operations. The warning highlights ongoing regional security risks associated with the conflict.

sources.headline: Businesses supporting Ukraine told to 'act now' to protect against Russian sabotage

europe_now.title: EU rejects maritime pact
europe_now.summary: European institutions have formally rejected a controversial agreement between Libya and Turkey that could permit oil drilling within Greek waters. Officials deemed the pact null and void regarding its impact on maritime boundaries.

sources.headline: ‘Null and void’: EU rejects Libya-Turkey pact that could allow oil drilling in Greek waters

top_stories.title: Migrant returns and court rulings
top_stories.summary: The European rights court has addressed legal frameworks and government pressures concerning the return of asylum seekers to Belarus. Multiple regional governments have engaged with the court's evolving jurisprudence on migration policy.
